Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Note for Bidders: SUPPLY OF MATERIAL AS PER FOLLOWING SPECIFICATIONS: Item Nu Item Code Item Description mber UOM Qty. SODIUM LAURYL SULPHATE Analytical Reagent Grad 1 300078058 e AS PER FOLLOWING SPECIFICATIONS. ACTIVE MATTER 90-92%. KG 500 PH OF 1% AQ.SOLN. 8.5 - 10.5 SIGNED AND STAMP NOTE FOR THE VENDORS: Terms and conditions- 1. Certificate of analysis from NABL accredited lab/Manufacture in-house/OEM and MSDS shall be supplied along with supply. 2. Material received at RCF Thal shall be inspected by RCF Thal. 3. RCF representative will draw sample and analysis will be carried out at RCF’s lab oratory with relevant IS STD. The results obtained at RCF’s laboratory will be final and binding to supplier. The consignment shall be rejected if it does not meet the PO specification. 4. Shelf life of Sodium Lauryl Sulphate shall be minimum 12 months.

5. Material should be free from lumps and moisture contamination. Technical Conditions 1. The material shall conform to the applicable manufacturer's product specification for Analytical Rea gent Grade and shall meet the following requirements, subject to verification against the manufactur er's technical datasheet: o o Chemical Name: Sodium Lauryl Sulphate o CAS Number: 151-21-3 o Grade:Analytical Reagent Grade o Purity: Minimum 99.0% o Sodium Lauryl Sulphate: Minimum 99.0% by mass o Sodium Sulphate: Maximum 3.83% by mass o Sodium Chloride: Maximum 1.5% by mass o Arsenic: Maximum 1 ppm o Heavy Metals as Pb: Maximum 20 ppm o pH: 7.5–9.5 o Melting Point: 204–207°C o Molar Mass: Approximately 288.3 g/mol o Chemical Formula: C₁₂H₂₅NaO₄S o Solubility in Water: As per applicable product specification o Packaging: 250-gram plastic bottle. 2. A Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued by an NABL-accredited laboratory, the manufacturer's in-ho use laboratory or the OEM, along with the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS), shall be supplied wit h every consignment. 3. The material received at RCF Thal shall be inspected by RCF. Samples may be drawn by the RCF representative and analysed/verified in the RCF laboratory. The analytical/inspection results obtain ed at the RCF laboratory shall be final and binding. The consignment shall be rejected if it does not meet the Purchase Order specifications. 4. Delivery shall be made at the RCF Thal site. 6. Acceptance / Rejection Criteria · The material shall conform to the specified Analytical Reagent Grade requirements and the applic able manufacturer's product specification.

· The purity of Sodium Lauryl Sulphate shall be a minimum of 99.0%. · If the supplied material does not conform to the specified technical requirements, the consignme nt shall be liable for rejection * Following documents to be submitted for qualification of your offer: Pre-Qualification Criteria- 1. Both the parties shall appoint the sole arbitrator wit h mutual agreement in line with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. Th e provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and as amended fro m time to time shall apply to the proceedings conducted under the arbitration . In case the party (parties) fail to appoint the sole arbitrator within 30 days fro m the date of request, the requesting party may approach the Court of Compe tent jurisdiction to appoint an Arbitrator. The decision of such arbitrator shall be final and binding on the parties. The v enue of Arbitration shall be at Mumbai. The language of the Arbitration shall b e English. b.
